first_missing_criterion: canonical BUILDING_PRESENT parcel AOI plus dataset-specific confirmation of the coordinate reference system and archive-internal DTM tile filenames for the Belfast City 2006 North East Zone. This unused official Spatial NI Data Supply: Metadata form requires a Data Supply Spatial Reference System and lists Irish Grid (TM65) [EPSG:29902] as a Spatial NI supply option; it also uses Belfast as an example geographic extent. The form is general supply guidance, not Belfast City 2006 LiDAR dataset metadata, so EPSG:29902 is not assigned to the LiDAR dataset and no tile filename, geometry, CRS binding or parcel binding is fabricated.
